context: Existing project structure and tooling analysis
content:
User's existing Anki tooling context:
1. Already uses `genanki` library for .apkg generation (see sap-c02/tools/gen_anki_deck.py)

   - /Users/murivirg/work/courses/aws-solutions-architect-professional-sap-c02 (1 .apkg)

   - /Users/murivirg/work/github/anki/anki-main (DVA questions, languages, SAW)
   - /Users/murivirg/work/github/anki/koine-pimsleur (audio decks with TTS)
3. User wants a LOCAL HTTP API (not MCP server), with file locking for concurrency
4. .apkg format is acceptable as the interchange format
5. The workflow is: LLM agents call API -> API manages decks -> eliminates manual delete/import cycle
6. koine-pimsleur has audio/media files (TTS generated) that need to be included in decks

User already has AnkiConnect addon installed (ID: 2055492159) at ~/Library/Application Support/Anki2/addons21/2055492159/. This means we can use AnkiConnect's REST API (default port 8765) when Anki desktop is running. Also has genanki 0.13.1 installed via pip.
